title: Street Fighter Rotten Tomatoes score? Above 50
rules: If Street Fighter has a Tomatometer score of above 50 on Oct 19, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
The "Fresh!" and "Certified Fresh!" subtitles are meant for illustrative purposes only. The Tomatometer score must be above the strike value to resolve as YES (for example, a score of 75 would resolve "Above 75" as No.) The market will be determined the Monday after wide release at 10:00 AM ET.

This market and these products have not been endorsed by Rotten Tomatoes. Any references to Rotten Tomatoes or any associated marks are descriptive only and do not indicate an endorsement of this product or any affiliation between Rotten Tomatoes and Kalshi.

blind.reasoning: Recent video-game adaptations cluster around 40-60% on Rotten Tomatoes. Earlier Street Fighter films scored very poorly, but this one has a comedy-minded director, trailers that were well received for leaning into the game's campy energy, and enthusiastic cast comments. With no critic reviews found before forecasting, it's roughly a coin flip, leaning slightly below the 50% line.
blind.falsifier: Reviews published before or on release weekend that put the Tomatometer clearly above 60% (or clearly below 40%) by Oct 19, 2026.

final.reasoning: The market at 64.5% sits well above my 48% estimate, and traders may have early critic reactions I couldn't access, so I moved up to about 57%. The remaining gap is small relative to that information disadvantage, so I won't bet against the price.
